text:
The eye's router steps to Gemini only when Ollama is DOWN; when Ollama answers but holds no model (`/api/tags` empty),
every judged act fails with "ollama returned 404 for POST /api/chat" while `doctor` passes (its line only notes
OLLAMA_HOST). All six sheets failed this way. The doctor's ollama line should list the models and fail on an empty
list, and the router should treat a 404 as down (lib/foundry/scout/doctorOllama.ts, lib/text/providers/ollama.ts).
